discovery.area: B4 labs (Layer 6): Anthropic, OpenAI, Google DeepMind, Meta, xAI
discovery.summary: Meta published v2.1 (2 Oct 2026), renamed Meta Superintelligence Scaling Framework, and announced a board AI committee (meta-v21). xAI's 30 Jun 2026 edition was re-hosted unchanged at a new URL after the old PDF went 404; SpaceX acquired xAI (Feb 2026) and x.ai now names SpaceX Super Intelligence LLC (SpaceXSI) (xai-spacex). No new versions for Anthropic (RSP v3.4), OpenAI (Preparedness v2) or Google DeepMind (FSF v3.1). Outside this slice, all five labs signed the White House Accord on Super Intelligence (29 Sep 2026), which Meta cites as the reason for v2.1.
